notes:
- Reverb — random-pop fix: eliminated the intermittent pops/clicks that could occur on idle or paused tracks. The reverb now declares an honest tail length (so the host no longer sleeps the effect mid-ring), its spectrum analyzer runs fully lock-free off the audio thread, and its silence handling drains cleanly to true zero.
- Reverb — engine overhaul: the feedback network was rebuilt with double the modal density for a smoother, denser, less "metallic" tail closer to high-end algorithmic reverbs, with decorrelated stereo output for cleaner lows and a softer onset.
- Reverb — expanded preset library: a large, re-voiced set spanning air/ambience, small+big spaces, rooms, halls, plates, chambers, plus dedicated vocal and drum presets — every preset shaped with a low-cut/high-cut (and shelves) so it sits in a mix out of the box.
- Undo / Redo: fixed undo over-shooting (reverting too many steps at once) and, inside a DAW, no longer hijacks the host's own Edit → Undo/Redo. Continuous knob drags collapse into a single undo step.
- Multiband Compressor: loudness-match no longer floods the undo history, and auto-gain writes are throttled so Redo stays available.
- Stability: a universal safety net on every built-in effect scrubs non-finite samples and hard-limits runaway levels, so nothing can produce an ear-damaging spike.
